## Independent reviewer reproduction

Run from a shell where TLS verification is not disabled:

```powershell
$env:NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED = '1'
$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE = '1'
corepack pnpm --version
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm run ci
py -3 -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p "test_*.py" -v
git diff --check
git status --short
```

Pass means pnpm reports `11.23.0`; frozen install passes the lockfile supply-chain policy; full CI exits `0` with 2 unit tests and the forbidden-import/schema pass messages; the governance suite reports 7 passing tests; and only the exact paths above differ from base commit `3a3302099f6e78e786dbc0fc5d78f13723a366d4`.
